args.content:
# Airi OS

Airi OS is a reproducible Debian-based live operating system dedicated to Airi-PC.

## Design

Airi OS does **not** reinvent the Linux kernel. It uses Debian 13 (Trixie) as the stable hardware and package foundation, then turns Airi-PC into a first-class system service.

Core properties:

- Debian 13 / amd64 live ISO
- XFCE desktop with Airi branding
- Airi-PC preinstalled under `/opt/airi-pc`
- Airi-PC starts automatically through systemd
- Playwright/Xvfb/Openbox tooling prepared at image-build time
- persistent Airi control-plane/auth state under `/var/lib/airi-pc`
- atomic `airi-update` with test-before-switch
- `airi-rollback` to return to the previous verified release
- `airi-status` for a quick runtime health check

The first version is deliberately a **bootable live appliance**. Disk installation can be added after the live image and recovery path have been validated on real hardware.

## Build

On Debian/Ubuntu with `live-build` and `xorriso` installed:

```bash
sudo bash airi-os/build.sh
```

The resulting ISO and checksum are written to `airi-os/out/`.

## Runtime

Airi-PC listens locally on port 9010. From the desktop:

```bash
airi-status
```

Update to the latest verified `main`:

```bash
sudo airi-update
```

Rollback:

```bash
sudo airi-rollback
```

#!/bin/sh
set -eu

lb config noauto \
  --mode debian \
  --architectures amd64 \
  --distribution trixie \
  --archive-areas "main contrib non-free non-free-firmware" \
  --binary-images iso-hybrid \
  --security false \
  --debian-installer none \
  --apt-recommends true \
  --memtest none \
  --bootappend-live "boot=live components username=airi hostname=airi-os locales=it_IT.UTF-8 keyboard-layouts=it timezone=Europe/Rome" \
  "$@"

[Unit]
Description=Airi-PC autonomous execution runtime
After=network-online.target graphical.target
Wants=network-online.target
ConditionPathExists=/opt/airi-pc/current/computer/start.sh

[Service]
Type=forking
User=airi-pc
Group=airi-pc
WorkingDirectory=/opt/airi-pc/current
Environment=AIRI_ROOT=/opt/airi-pc/current
Environment=AIRIPC_WORKSPACE_ROOT=/opt/airi-pc/current
Environment=AIRIPC_VENV=/opt/airi-pc/venv-current
Environment=AIRI_LOG_DIR=/var/lib/airi-pc/logs
Environment=PLAYWRIGHT_BROWSERS_PATH=/opt/airi-pc/playwright
Environment=AIRI_LIVE_TELEMETRY=1
PIDFile=/var/lib/airi-pc/logs/computer-server.pid
ExecStart=/bin/sh /opt/airi-pc/current/computer/start.sh
ExecStop=/bin/sh /opt/airi-pc/current/scripts/airi-stop
Restart=on-failure
RestartSec=5
TimeoutStartSec=180
TimeoutStopSec=30
NoNewPrivileges=true
PrivateTmp=true

[Install]
WantedBy=multi-user.target

#!/bin/sh
set -eu
printf '\nAiri OS runtime status\n'
printf '%s\n' '----------------------'
printf 'Release: '
readlink -f /opt/airi-pc/current 2>/dev/null || true
printf 'Service: '
systemctl is-active airi-pc.service 2>/dev/null || true
printf 'Ready:   '
if curl -fsS --max-time 3 http://127.0.0.1:9010/ready; then
  printf '\n'
else
  printf 'not ready\n'
fi
printf 'Logs:    /var/lib/airi-pc/logs\n'

#!/bin/bash
set -euo pipefail

[ "$(id -u)" -eq 0 ] || { echo "airi-update must run as root" >&2; exit 1; }

BASE=/opt/airi-pc
RELEASES=$BASE/releases
VENVS=$BASE/venvs
PERSIST=/var/lib/airi-pc
REPO=https://github.com/arancione3000/airi-pc-bootstrap.git
TMP=$RELEASES/.update-$$

cleanup() { rm -rf "$TMP"; }
trap cleanup EXIT

mkdir -p "$RELEASES" "$VENVS" "$PERSIST/control_plane" "$PERSIST/auth" "$PERSIST/logs" "$BASE/playwright"

echo "[Airi OS] Fetching canonical main..."
git clone --depth=1 --branch main "$REPO" "$TMP"
SHA=$(git -C "$TMP" rev-parse HEAD)
TARGET=$RELEASES/$SHA
VENV=$VENVS/$SHA

if [ -e "$TARGET" ]; then
  echo "[Airi OS] Release $SHA already exists."
  rm -rf "$TMP"
else
  mv "$TMP" "$TARGET"
fi
trap - EXIT

mkdir -p "$TARGET/.ai"
rm -rf "$TARGET/.ai/control_plane" "$TARGET/.ai/auth"
ln -s /var/lib/airi-pc/control_plane "$TARGET/.ai/control_plane"
ln -s /var/lib/airi-pc/auth "$TARGET/.ai/auth"

if [ ! -x "$VENV/bin/python" ]; then
  python3 -m venv "$VENV"
fi
"$VENV/bin/python" -m pip install --disable-pip-version-check --upgrade pip wheel
"$VENV/bin/python" -m pip install --disable-pip-version-check -r "$TARGET/requirements-dev.txt"
PLAYWRIGHT_BROWSERS_PATH=$BASE/playwright "$VENV/bin/python" -m playwright install chromium

echo "[Airi OS] Running verification before activation..."
(
  cd "$TARGET"
  export AIRI_ROOT="$TARGET"
  export AIRIPC_WORKSPACE_ROOT="$TARGET"
  export AIRIPC_VENV="$VENV"
  export AIRI_LIVE_TELEMETRY=0
  "$VENV/bin/python" -m pytest -q
  "$VENV/bin/python" -m compileall -q computer
)

OLD_CODE=$(readlink -f "$BASE/current" 2>/dev/null || true)
OLD_VENV=$(readlink -f "$BASE/venv-current" 2>/dev/null || true)

[ -z "$OLD_CODE" ] || ln -sfn "$OLD_CODE" "$BASE/previous"
[ -z "$OLD_VENV" ] || ln -sfn "$OLD_VENV" "$BASE/venv-previous"

ln -sfn "$TARGET" "$BASE/.current-next"
mv -Tf "$BASE/.current-next" "$BASE/current"
ln -sfn "$VENV" "$BASE/.venv-next"
mv -Tf "$BASE/.venv-next" "$BASE/venv-current"

chown -h airi-pc:airi-pc "$BASE/current" "$BASE/venv-current" 2>/dev/null || true
chown -R airi-pc:airi-pc "$PERSIST" "$TARGET" "$VENV" "$BASE/playwright"

systemctl restart airi-pc.service
sleep 2
airi-status

echo "[Airi OS] Activated $SHA"

#!/bin/bash
set -euo pipefail

[ "$(id -u)" -eq 0 ] || { echo "airi-rollback must run as root" >&2; exit 1; }

BASE=/opt/airi-pc
PREV=$(readlink -f "$BASE/previous" 2>/dev/null || true)
PREV_VENV=$(readlink -f "$BASE/venv-previous" 2>/dev/null || true)
CUR=$(readlink -f "$BASE/current" 2>/dev/null || true)
CUR_VENV=$(readlink -f "$BASE/venv-current" 2>/dev/null || true)

[ -n "$PREV" ] && [ -d "$PREV" ] || { echo "No previous Airi-PC release available." >&2; exit 2; }
[ -n "$PREV_VENV" ] && [ -d "$PREV_VENV" ] || { echo "No previous Airi-PC environment available." >&2; exit 2; }

ln -sfn "$PREV" "$BASE/.current-next"
mv -Tf "$BASE/.current-next" "$BASE/current"
ln -sfn "$PREV_VENV" "$BASE/.venv-next"
mv -Tf "$BASE/.venv-next" "$BASE/venv-current"

[ -z "$CUR" ] || ln -sfn "$CUR" "$BASE/previous"
[ -z "$CUR_VENV" ] || ln -sfn "$CUR_VENV" "$BASE/venv-previous"

systemctl restart airi-pc.service
sleep 2
airi-status
echo "[Airi OS] Rollback complete."
airi ALL=(root) NOPASSWD: /usr/local/sbin/airi-update, /usr/local/sbin/airi-rollback, /bin/systemctl restart airi-pc.service, /bin/systemctl status airi-pc.service

#!/bin/bash
set -euo pipefail

BASE=/opt/airi-pc
RELEASE=$BASE/releases/builtin
VENV=$BASE/venvs/builtin
PERSIST=/var/lib/airi-pc

getent group airi-pc >/dev/null || groupadd --system airi-pc
id airi-pc >/dev/null 2>&1 || useradd --system --gid airi-pc --home-dir "$PERSIST" --create-home --shell /usr/sbin/nologin airi-pc

mkdir -p "$BASE/releases" "$BASE/venvs" "$BASE/playwright" "$PERSIST/control_plane" "$PERSIST/auth" "$PERSIST/logs"
mkdir -p "$RELEASE/.ai"
rm -rf "$RELEASE/.ai/control_plane" "$RELEASE/.ai/auth"
ln -s /var/lib/airi-pc/control_plane "$RELEASE/.ai/control_plane"
ln -s /var/lib/airi-pc/auth "$RELEASE/.ai/auth"

python3 -m venv "$VENV"
"$VENV/bin/python" -m pip install --disable-pip-version-check --upgrade pip wheel
"$VENV/bin/python" -m pip install --disable-pip-version-check -r "$RELEASE/requirements-dev.txt"
PLAYWRIGHT_BROWSERS_PATH=$BASE/playwright "$VENV/bin/python" -m playwright install-deps chromium
PLAYWRIGHT_BROWSERS_PATH=$BASE/playwright "$VENV/bin/python" -m playwright install chromium

ln -sfn "$RELEASE" "$BASE/current"
ln -sfn "$VENV" "$BASE/venv-current"

chmod 0755 /usr/local/bin/airi-status /usr/local/sbin/airi-update /usr/local/sbin/airi-rollback
chmod 0440 /etc/sudoers.d/airi-os
chmod +x "$RELEASE/computer/start.sh" "$RELEASE/scripts/airi-stop" 2>/dev/null || true

chown -R airi-pc:airi-pc "$PERSIST" "$RELEASE" "$VENV" "$BASE/playwright"
chown -h airi-pc:airi-pc "$BASE/current" "$BASE/venv-current"

systemctl enable NetworkManager.service
systemctl enable lightdm.service
systemctl enable airi-pc.service

[Desktop Entry]
Type=Application
Name=Airi Status
Comment=Show Airi-PC runtime health
Exec=xfce4-terminal --hold -e airi-status
Icon=utilities-system-monitor
Terminal=false
Categories=System;

#!/bin/bash
set -euo pipefail

OS_DIR=$(CDPATH= cd -- "$(dirname -- "$0")" && pwd)
ROOT=$(CDPATH= cd -- "$OS_DIR/.." && pwd)
WORK=$OS_DIR/build-work
OUT=$OS_DIR/out
ISO_NAME=Airi-OS-0.1-amd64.iso

command -v lb >/dev/null || { echo "live-build (lb) is required" >&2; exit 2; }
command -v xorriso >/dev/null || { echo "xorriso is required" >&2; exit 2; }
[ "$(id -u)" -eq 0 ] || { echo "Run build.sh as root (sudo)." >&2; exit 2; }

rm -rf "$WORK" "$OUT"
mkdir -p "$WORK" "$OUT"
cp -a "$OS_DIR/auto" "$WORK/"
cp -a "$OS_DIR/config" "$WORK/"

DEST=$WORK/config/includes.chroot/opt/airi-pc/releases/builtin
mkdir -p "$DEST"
git -C "$ROOT" archive --format=tar HEAD | tar -xf - -C "$DEST"
mkdir -p "$DEST/.ai"
git -C "$ROOT" rev-parse HEAD > "$DEST/.ai/.runtime_source_sha"

chmod +x "$WORK/auto/config"
find "$WORK/config/hooks" -type f -name '*.hook.chroot' -exec chmod +x {} +

cd "$WORK"
bash auto/config
lb build

SOURCE_ISO=live-image-amd64.hybrid.iso
[ -s "$SOURCE_ISO" ] || { echo "live-build did not produce $SOURCE_ISO" >&2; exit 3; }
cp "$SOURCE_ISO" "$OUT/$ISO_NAME"
(
  cd "$OUT"
  sha256sum "$ISO_NAME" > "$ISO_NAME.sha256"
)

echo "AIRI_OS_ISO=$OUT/$ISO_NAME"
cat "$OUT/$ISO_NAME.sha256"

#!/bin/bash
set -euo pipefail

ROOT=$(CDPATH= cd -- "$(dirname -- "$0")/.." && pwd)
OS=$ROOT/airi-os

required=(
  "$OS/auto/config"
  "$OS/config/package-lists/airi.list.chroot"
  "$OS/config/includes.chroot/etc/systemd/system/airi-pc.service"
  "$OS/config/includes.chroot/usr/local/bin/airi-status"
  "$OS/config/includes.chroot/usr/local/sbin/airi-update"
  "$OS/config/includes.chroot/usr/local/sbin/airi-rollback"
  "$OS/config/hooks/live/010-airi-setup.hook.chroot"
  "$OS/build.sh"
)
for f in "${required[@]}"; do
  [ -s "$f" ] || { echo "missing required file: $f" >&2; exit 1; }
done

bash -n "$OS/build.sh"
bash -n "$OS/auto/config"
bash -n "$OS/config/hooks/live/010-airi-setup.hook.chroot"
bash -n "$OS/config/includes.chroot/usr/local/sbin/airi-update"
bash -n "$OS/config/includes.chroot/usr/local/sbin/airi-rollback"

grep -q 'distribution trixie' "$OS/auto/config"
grep -q 'airi-pc.service' "$OS/config/hooks/live/010-airi-setup.hook.chroot"
grep -q 'Running verification before activation' "$OS/config/includes.chroot/usr/local/sbin/airi-update"
grep -q 'AIRI_LIVE_TELEMETRY=1' "$OS/config/includes.chroot/etc/systemd/system/airi-pc.service"

echo "AIRI_OS_SOURCE_VERIFY=PASS"

args.command: bash airi-os/verify.sh && grep -q -- '--security false' airi-os/auto/config && grep -q 'trixie-security' airi-os/config/archives/trixie-security.list.chroot airi-os/config/archives/trixie-security.list.binary

docker pull debian:trixie && docker run --privileged --rm -e DEBIAN_FRONTEND=noninteractive -v "$PWD:/workspace" -w /workspace debian:trixie bash -lc 'apt-get update && apt-get install -y live-build xorriso git ca-certificates && git config --global --add safe.directory /workspace && bash airi-os/build.sh'

steps.title: Inspect ISO boot metadata and checksum

args.command: test -s airi-os/out/Airi-OS-0.1-amd64.iso && cd airi-os/out && sha256sum -c Airi-OS-0.1-amd64.iso.sha256 && xorriso -indev Airi-OS-0.1-amd64.iso -report_el_torito plain >/tmp/airi-os-el-torito.txt 2>&1 && grep -qi 'El Torito' /tmp/airi-os-el-torito.txt

notes: ISO build isolated in Debian Trixie container; checksum manifest made portable across container/host boundary.
